sentences.text:
Dipak Mallik .... Petitioner
 Mr. S.K. Tripathy, Advocate
 -versus-
 State of Odisha & Another .... Opposite Parties
 Mr. C.R. Swain, Aga
 Coram: Justice V. Narasingh
 Order
Order No. 24.12.2025
 01. 1.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and  learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with C.R. Case No.773 of 2023 pending on the file of learned J.M.F.C., Aul arising out of Rajkanika P.S. Case No.331 of 2023 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 376(1)/ 506/ 417/ 34 of the IPC.
3. Informant be noticed through the I.O.
Extra copy of the brief for the purpose be served on the learned counsel for the State by 29.12.2025 as well.
Learned counsel for the State is called upon to obtain the Case Diary in the meanwhile.
5. As an interim measure, it is directed that the Petitioner shall not be taken into custody in connection with the aforesaid case, till the next date.
6. It is needless to say that the Petitioner shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency.
7. Copy of this order be made over to the learned counsel for the State to do the needful.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge amit Location: HIGH COURT OF ORISSA, CUTTACK Dipak Mallik vs State Of Odisha & Another ....
